terminals.name: emulators
terminals.description: Firebase Auth + Firestore emulators (demo project, no real credentials). Firestore rules from firestore.rules. Emulator UI on http://localhost:4000.

terminals.name: api
terminals.description: Local auth API (/api/signup, /api/login, /api/reset-pin) on http://localhost:3000, backed by the emulators. Replaces `vercel dev` for local dev; waits for the emulators before serving. Invite code: demo-invite.

terminals.name: vite
terminals.description: Vite dev server for the Workout Planner PWA on http://localhost:5173. Proxies /api to the local auth API and uses the Firebase emulators (VITE_FIREBASE_EMULATOR from .env.development).
